citations.assessment: Earlier family entry lists Ivo as Rav’s father.
The Bavli specifies an unnamed man who brought the willow. The abbreviated Hebrew preserves the willow action and lack of blessing.
Rashi identifies this Ivo as Rav’s father.
Asheri explicitly reads Elazar bar Tzadok and quotes the action.
Tur preserves the Tzadok reading in its quotation of the argument.
